observation_summary: A NullPointerException is thrown when calling StringUtils.replaceEach with an array containing a null element.
reasoning_summary: The code in StringUtils.replaceEach iterates through the replacementList to calculate the buffer size for the result string. It attempts to call .length() on elements of the replacementList without checking if those elements are null. When a null value is present in the replacementList, the expression replacementList[i].length() throws a NullPointerException.
